methods.refit_cadence: first available trading day of each calendar year
methods.lookahead_policy: Forecasts for t are produced from state through t-1; day-t returns/range update the state only after forecast recording. Equivalent to signal.shift(1).
methods.var_loss: Empirical standardized-residual quantiles at 5% and 1%; pinball + Kupiec/CC
methods.sv_qml_note: SV variants are QML/Kalman approximations on log(r_t^2); RSV_KF adds Parkinson range log-variance as a second measurement. This is not a full Bayesian realized-SV skew-t implementation.
